name: data.store
title: Store data
summary: Write the data of the current state as JSON Lines to `<commit>.jsonl` in a folder, so that many states load as one table.
details: One element per line, as data export gives it; `-dirty` with uncommitted ReqSeq files; replaces the file of the same commit; an old `<commit>.json` stays as it is. The files are grouped by `commit` and `dirty`. One folder per selection: the name is the same for every selection. Takes `selection.baseline` as `data export` does.
whileReadOnlyReason: Stores the data of the current state with the versions of its elements, which depend on the metamodel (which properties count).

folder.description: Folder for the file; created when missing inside a repository of the workspace (also an ignored one), must exist outside.

items.description: Written file: relative to the workspace root when it lies in a repository of the workspace, else absolute.
